title: Violence Concepts
description: Canonical violence concepts for reviewer reasoning.

entries.title: Violence Event
entries.description: A violent act, harm event, or physical escalation.

entries.title: Violence Threat
entries.description: A threat, warning, or intimidation that signals harm.

entries.title: Violence Attempt
entries.description: An attempt to commit violence that may or may not succeed.

entries.title: Violence Glorification
entries.description: Praise, celebration, or normalization of violence.

entries.title: Violence Encouragement
entries.description: Encouraging someone else to use violence.

entries.title: Violence Instruction
entries.description: Operational guidance for violent action.

entries.title: Violence Reward
entries.description: Violence framed as rewarded, desirable, or beneficial.

entries.title: Violence Revenge
entries.description: Violence framed as retaliation or payback.

entries.title: Violence Self Defense
entries.description: Violence framed as self-defense or protection.

entries.title: Violence Law Enforcement
entries.description: Violence framed as police, security, or lawful force.

entries.title: Violence Accident
entries.description: Violence that happens by accident or unintended impact.

entries.title: Violence Negligence
entries.description: Violence caused by negligence, omission, or carelessness.

entries.title: Violence Condemnation
entries.description: Violence mentioned to reject, criticize, or condemn it.

entries.title: Violence Documentary
entries.description: Violence discussed in documentary or factual reporting context.

entries.title: Violence Historical
entries.description: Violence framed as a historical event or record.

entries.title: Violence Training
entries.description: Violence used in training, safety, or educational practice.

entries.title: Violence Game
entries.description: Violence embedded in a game, simulation, or play context.

entries.title: Violence Fantasy
entries.description: Violence in fantasy, mythic, or imaginary settings.

entries.title: Violence Comedy
entries.description: Violence played for humor, irony, or comedic effect.

entries.title: Violence Dream
entries.description: Violence appearing in a dream or dreamlike scene.

entries.title: Violence Flashback
entries.description: Violence shown as a flashback or recollection.

entries.title: Violence Memory
entries.description: Violence recalled from memory or remembered experience.

entries.title: Violence Imagination
entries.description: Violence imagined, hypothesized, or mentally simulated.

entries.title: Violence Failed Attempt
entries.description: A violent act that fails or is interrupted.

entries.title: Violence Offscreen
entries.description: Violence implied to occur outside the visible frame.

entries.title: Violence Scene Description
entries.description: Violence conveyed through descriptive scene language.

entries.title: Violence Dialogue
entries.description: Violence delivered in dialogue or quoted speech.

entries.title: Violence Reported by Character
entries.description: Violence described by one character about another event.

entries.title: Violence Observed
entries.description: Violence directly witnessed or observed by a character or narrator.

entries.title: Violence Implied
entries.description: Violence suggested by context rather than explicit wording.

entries.title: Violence Against Child
entries.description: Violence targeting a child or minor.

entries.title: Violence Against Woman
entries.description: Violence targeting a woman or female-presenting target.

entries.title: Violence Against Disabled
entries.description: Violence targeting a disabled person.

entries.title: Violence Against Public
entries.description: Violence targeting the public, crowd, or civilians.

entries.title: Violence Against State
entries.description: Violence targeting state institutions or authority.
